items.title: Nvidia's "Valuation Sanity Check", tech software debacles, and Anthropic IPO preview
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down some of the biggest movers in today's tech trade, including a look at Nvidia and its valuation, and why some analysts see that valuation as "draconian". Plus, a closer look at some of the recent tech debacles and outages and whether these trends will continue in the future.

Sozzi also speaks to Kevin O'Leary about the state of the tech market, including the Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) IPO and the rumors about Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.
